topic: How a multi-branch operation manages payroll for four locations from one screen
format: Open with a SmartPRO Hub product capability, then show the real-world business outcome it enables
post:
A retail group in Muscat cut payroll processing from four days to under two hours — across four branches, with zero spreadsheets.

They were running payroll through a mix of Excel files, WhatsApp messages, and a part-time accountant trying to keep it all from falling apart. Every month: three to four days of back-and-forth, regular errors, and WPS submissions that sometimes missed the deadline.

SmartPRO Hub pulled all four branches into one payroll dashboard. Attendance, deductions, and allowances from each location land in a single screen. WPS files generate automatically and go straight to the bank.

They haven't missed a WPS deadline since.

We built this because four branches shouldn't require a dedicated finance team just to get payroll out the door. The complexity isn't something to manage around — it's the thing that needs to go.

Customers aren't paying for a sophisticated system. They're paying to stop doing this by hand.

If you're running more than one location and still reconciling payroll manually, that time has a real cost. It compounds every month.

What's the one payroll bottleneck your team keeps working around?
